review.note: M51: the interval is not from memory and not the two actors' own. Its date is Wikidata's, named in this record's citation by item and property, and `note` says which. There is nothing here to check against a year somebody remembered.

note: The two records stand on the same ground across the 1885/1886 seam — 89.79% of the smaller outline — but "Turkey (Ottoman Empire)" names two polities, so the seam is closed as a succession and not as a join. The date is Wikidata's P576 on Q12560 and is the only date here not already in the atlas.
